pages.text: ORSA paperwork survived the evacuation better than ORSA did.$(br2)$(bold)ORSA Documents$() turn up in chests in villages, mineshafts, dungeons, strongholds, outposts, temples, igloos, ancient cities and end cities.
ORSA camps, stations, vehicles and cargo drops carry their own.

Right-click a document to archive it. The document is consumed and its entry in this chapter unlocks.$(br2)Entries marked (Locked) are documents you have not found yet.$(br2)$(italic)Archived material remains ORSA property. So do you.$()
